title: NZ School Holidays Travel Tips — How to Beat the Crowds and Save Money
meta_desc: Discover NZ school holidays travel tips to avoid crowds and save money, with insider advice on booking times and prices
intro: Travelling during NZ school holidays can be a costly affair, with prices for accommodation and activities often inflated by up to 50%. However, with some smart planning, you can beat the crowds and save money. For instance, consider visiting popular destinations like Rotorua, which offers a range of affordable activities such as the Whakarewarewa Māori Village and Te Puia, priced at around $50-$70 per person.

sections.heading: Understanding Peak and Off-Peak Pricing
sections.body: In New Zealand, peak season typically falls during the summer months (December to February) and school holidays, while off-peak season includes the winter months (June to August) and weekdays during the school term. For example, a night's stay at the Novotel Rotorua Lakeside can cost around $250 during peak season, compared to $180 during off-peak season.

sections.heading: Booking Lead Times
list: Book your accommodation at least 3-6 months in advance to secure the best prices
Consider booking activities and tours 1-2 months in advance to avoid sell-outs
Be flexible with your travel dates and consider travelling during the shoulder season (April to May or September to November) for better deals

sections.heading: Driving Times and Distances
sections.body: When planning your road trip, be sure to factor in driving times and distances. For example, the drive from Auckland to Rotorua takes around 3 hours, while the drive from Wellington to Queenstown takes around 10 hours. Consider breaking up your journey with overnight stays in towns like Taupo or Wanaka.

sections.heading: Saving Money on Activities
list: Consider purchasing a family pass for popular attractions like the Skyline Gondola in Queenstown, priced at around $120 for a family of four
Look for discount codes and special promotions on the websites of activity providers, such as the $20 off coupon for the Whakarewarewa Māori Village
Take advantage of free activities like hiking and visiting local beaches, such as the popular Hot Water Beach in the Coromandel

sections.heading: Get Ready for Your Next Family Adventure
sections.body: With these tips and tricks, you're ready to start planning your next family adventure in NZ. Remember to book early, be flexible, and take advantage of discounts and promotions to save money. Happy travels!
